tools.name: search_wallets
tools.description: Search the FIDES wallet catalog for digital identity wallets. Filter by free-text query, organization, type, platform, supported credential (VC) format, capabilities, interoperability profiles, open-source, and status. Returns a compact, paginated list with canonical detail URLs.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Get full details of a single FIDES wallet by its organization id and wallet id (from search_wallets). Returns the complete record including provider, supported credential formats, protocols, key storage, certifications, and links.

tools.name: search_credential_types
tools.description: Search the FIDES credential catalog for credential type definitions (schema, VC format, subject kind, authority, sectors, ecosystems, themes). tools.name: get_credential_type
tools.description: Get full details of a single FIDES credential type by its catalog id (from search_credential_types).

tools.name: search_organizations
tools.description: Search the FIDES organization catalog for organizations and their ecosystem roles (issuer, credential, wallet, relying party). tools.name: get_organization
tools.description: Get full details of a single FIDES organization by its catalog id (from search_organizations), e.g. 'org:animo'. Includes catalogTier (Community or Pro), offerings, tags, and contact when the org is on a Pro plan.

tools.name: search_issuers
tools.description: Search the FIDES issuer catalog for credential issuers — who issues which credentials, in which environment, with which configurations. tools.name: get_issuer

tools.name: search_relying_parties
tools.description: Search the FIDES relying party catalog for verifier websites and services that accept verifiable credentials. Filter by free-text, country, owning organization, readiness, status, interaction mode, sector, and accepted credential format. Returns a compact, paginated list with canonical detail URLs.

tools.name: get_relying_party
tools.description: Get full details of a single FIDES relying party by its catalog id (from search_relying_parties), e.g. 'air-new-zealand'.

tools.name: get_use_case
tools.description: Get full details of a single FIDES use case by its catalog id (from search_use_cases), e.g. 'age-verification-online-purchase'.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across all FIDES catalogs (wallets, credential types, organizations, issuers) with a free-text query. Returns a list of results with ids and canonical URLs; use the `fetch` tool with a result id to retrieve full details.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full record for a single FIDES catalog item by the result id returned from the `search` tool. Returns the document with a canonical URL for citation.

tools.name: read_site_page

If hasMore=true, call again with nextOffset only when more text is needed. Only the configured FIDES site origin is allowed.

findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
